authorization: Chris supplied Production Batch Blend Sheet contract; implement only after all required captured component quantities are authoritative. No hosted writes, migration application, push or deployment.

aggregate.basis: Captured batchChipTargetLb 180 × operator-authored percentage / 100; calculated aggregate rows must reconcile to 100%.

filler.derivation: 180/128 = 1.40625 CFT; captured 512 oz/CFT × 1.40625 /16 = 45 lb. Manual captured Working Pour overrides project proportionally; 32 oz =>90 lb without changing chips.

resin.derivation: Captured MTT 480 fl oz/CFT ×1.40625 =675 fl oz =5.2734375 US gal.

hardener.derivation: Captured 5:1 ratio:675/5=135 fl oz =1.0546875 US gal. Other captured rates/4:1 ratios remain distinct.

authoritativeComponents.other: Every additional row must have an explicit supported role/quantity/unit; unavailable rows block the whole Production output. All supported profiles require aggregate, filler, resin and hardener rows.

acceptedProvenance: Existing 180-lb captured target, 128-lb/CFT captured density and .375-inch reference derive 45 SF/4 lbSF. No formulation math changed. Shared projection compared byte-for-byte to transpiled base candidate.

catalogPackageSource.reviewCatalog: Existing read-only local snapshot, 1951 Regular +301 active Specialty entries; no hosted reads or writes needed in this task.

packageCapture.timing: New/reselected catalog material; existing save/version/issue snapshot infrastructure preserves it. No historical backfill or live reinterpretation.
packageCapture.conversion: Batch lb / captured package mass; lb, oz and kg supported; two decimals with approximation marker in model. Exact Batch quantity remains primary. No default package weight.
packageCapture.missing: Batch output remains available; Package Eq. reads Unavailable. Unknown container type is package, never assumed bag.

lifecycle.working: Current Draft is saved using existing convention, then server fetches its Working snapshot; prominent WORKING BATCH BLEND - NOT ISSUED on every PDF page.
lifecycle.issued: Explicit issue selector; server reads immutable issued_snapshot under existing operational access/RLS; draft edits and catalog/profile changes ignored. No separate issuance or stored artifact lifecycle.
lifecycle.pdfVersion: production-batch-blend-v1; read-only export of selected source issue, not a new approval.
lifecycle.legacy: Missing captured Batch target or required component semantics disables output and server rejects generation. Missing reference thickness only suppresses yield; missing packages only suppress equivalents.

inventoryBoundary: No lot/on-hand/consumption/reservation/stock/Inventory calls or writes. Issued export also has no Sample, Storage or service-client mutation.

implementation.reuse: Accepted Batch projection extracted to shared MJS unchanged; dedicated compact renderer reuses PDF fonts, text normalization, measured wrapping, existing edge endpoint and document viewer. Working Sample renderer/model unchanged.
implementation.ui: Production Batch Blend Sheet card with Source formulation selector for Current Draft or a specific Issue. Generate Production Batch Blend Sheet button; current Working Sheet action retained.
implementation.migration: None. Existing catalog_snapshot JSON and immutable issue snapshots are sufficient.
